chunks: With this chain, from 'Asim ibn Abi Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever recites Surah Al-Jathiya, its reward is that he will not see the Fire forever, nor hear the sighing of Hell, nor its gasping, and he will be with Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.سُورَةَ الْجَاثِيَةِ: Surah Al-Jathiya (The Kneeling), the 45th chapter of the Quran
key_terms.مُحَمَّدٍ ص: Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Al-Jathiya according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith emphasizes the eschatological benefit of reciting Surah Al-Jathiya, linking the physical act of recitation to the spiritual state of being spared from the auditory and visual torments of Hell. The promise of dwelling 'with Muhammad' underscores the Shia concept of *wilayah* and proximity to the Prophet as the ultimate reward for this devotion.
